title: Production refuses a remote DATABASE_URL without verified TLS
why: A production backend whose remote DATABASE_URL lacks sslmode=verify-full no longer boots (BDB_TLS_UNVERIFIED); local databases are unaffected.
steps: In the [production] section of .brain_env, add `sslmode=verify-full` to a remote DATABASE_URL (and the CA the provider documents).
Run `brain backend serve` against production settings once to confirm it boots.
